notes: Validated against Serganov et al. Nature 2006 (doi:10.1038/nature04740). 2GDI structure: Arabidopsis thaliana TPP riboswitch with CCC (pyrithiamine PP analog). CRITICAL: thiazole ring is NOT recognised by the RNA — only the aminopyrimidine (HMP) arm and pyrophosphate tail are contacted. Aminopyrimidine: continuous stacking A41-G42-HMP-A43-G21; base triples (G19·A47)·G42 and (G18-C48)·A41 stabilise the pocket. G40 and G19 2′-OH H-bond to polar aminopyrimidine groups. Pyrophosphate: two Mg²⁺ ions (Mg1/Mg2) coordinate the phosphate oxygens; Mg1 directly contacts G60 O6 and G78 O6; C77 and G78 H-bond terminal phosphate. Chain X used for 2GDI (two-chain ASU).
